_why: Lens D — routes that exist on the server but that the SPA never calls, so lenses A/B/C are structurally blind to all of them. Recovered from Django's own 404 debug page, which lists every pattern in the resolver it reached (see scripts/enumerate_urlconf.py). 228 routes exist; the bundle harvest found 125. This is also why OMS should turn DEBUG off — the same page is served to an anonymous caller.
_safety: Every entry below was probed with a BARE GET, no query parameters, which is the sanctioned safe probe. Nothing here was probed with an invented parameter value. Anything write-shaped by name, or that answered 405, or that reached SAP's document API, is in `excluded` and was never called again.
_confidence: These are published on live-probe evidence (a 200, or a 400 naming its own required params) but WITHOUT the depth of a phase-3 domain study: no response-field walkthrough, no tenant matrix, no trap analysis. Descriptions say what the probe proved and no more. Treat them as sound but shallower than the rest of the spec.

_note_on_scope: 41 read-shaped routes were found; 19 are published here. The remainder are parameterised with no observed key value, or are duplicates, or belong to modules (einvoice IRN lifecycle, ewaybill) whose reads and writes share prefixes closely enough that studying them properly is its own job. They are listed in `excluded` with a reason rather than left unmentioned, so the next run starts from a complete picture.
